gloss: dressing table; vanity table; dresser with mirror

definitions.gloss: dressing table; vanity table; dresser with mirror
definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with a mirror used for applying makeup and grooming. Traditionally an important item in a Japanese bride's trousseau.

examples.japanese: {鏡台|きょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I sat in front of the dressing table.

examples.english: Every morning, my mother would carefully apply her makeup in front of the dressing table.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, a {鏡台|きょうだい} was an essential item in a bride's {嫁入|よめい}り⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (trousseau). Japanese-style {鏡台|きょうだい} are low, designed to be used while sitting on the floor ({座|すわ}り{鏡台|きょうだい}). Western-style standing versions are also called {鏡台|きょうだい} or ⟦ドレッサー→ドレッサー：23739_doressaa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鏡台|きょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in front of the dressing table)
- {鏡台|きょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧ (dressing table drawers)
- {鏡台|きょうだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (to sit at the dressing table)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧ (siblings).
